ece.entry: Applicants pick a major or an intended combined major on the Northeastern application and can declare it on admission. Later switches into engineering need a 2.0 GPA and at least a C in one required math course and one engineering chemistry or physics course.
ece.notes: No formal robotics concentration exists in BSEE or BSCmpE. EECE 2160 is required in BSCmpE and in the combined major. BSCmpE has four technical electives, which can include EECE 5000-level robotics courses (5550, 5554, 5580, 5639); the catalog lists the 5000-level courses as electives in the major and the prerequisites are undergraduate courses. BSCmpE is 133 semester hours; the combined CmpE and CS major is 140. Both end with a two-semester capstone (EECE 4791 and EECE 4792).
